ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across ~85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) comprising approximately 15% of the area, concentrated in the distal tips and scattered mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous clusters are located at the lateral distal tips of both lobes. A distinct medium-sized high-contrast patch is visible on the lower medial portion of the right lobe. Numerous micro-clusters (white mottling) are distributed semi-uniformly across the central and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 60-70 degrees; depth is significant, creating a sharp cleft between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low-to-medium pixel amplitude along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks are localized on the outer third of the right lobe's upper edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on the lower boundaries, transitioning to slightly tapered, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are scattered across the central and lateral surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmentation/white scarring at the terminal lateral tips and a larger concentration of white patches on the inner right lobe near the center.
